**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on us. All pricing hooks (§11 Fees, §10 maintenance fees, §2 additional-location fees, §17 perpetuity subject to fee payment, §10(c) repair rates) merely cross-refer to the Fee Schedule, and targeted searches for "most favoured/favourable", "no less favourable", "best price", "other customers" and "competitor" returned nothing; §20 General Matters contains no best-terms covenant either. This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position — no MFN burdening the Customer — so there is nothing to delete. Worth noting only as a negotiation upside: a Garman-granted MFN in our favour would be welcome but is not present.
